papers.title: Change2Task: From Repository Changes to Executable Coding Agent Tasks and Environments
papers.abstract: Scaling coding agents requires a continuing supply of executable data for training, benchmarking, and continuous evaluation. Each task must couple a realistic software state with a specification, development tools, and reliable verification. To expand this supply, we present Change2Task, a system grounded in repository history that converts merged pull requests into verified tasks on healthy modern revisions of the same repository. It aligns historical evidence with evolved code, reconstructs ta
papers.llm_reason: 直击 coding agent 规模化的核心瓶颈：持续供给可执行的训练/评测任务。据摘要：Change2Task 从仓库历史中的已合并 PR 出发，把历史证据与演化后的代码对齐，在仓库的健康现代版本上重建任务环境（规范 + 开发工具 + 可靠验证），将 PR 转化为已验证任务。这同时命中 coding-agent、evaluation、benchmark 三条主线——为团队自建 coding agent 评测集与训练数据管道提供了可立即借鉴的工程方法。工程价值高：'从真实 PR 反向构造可执行任务 + 自动验证'是一个可复用的任务生成范式，不依赖人工标注即可持续扩展。证据强度依赖论文正文（任务验证的准确率、跨仓库泛化与人工质检对照待核验），代码/benchmark 链接暂无待核验。

papers.title: ReToken: One Token to Improve Vision-Language Models for Visual Retrieval
papers.abstract: Long visual context poses a challenge for vision-language models: performance degrades as the number of distractors grows, and processing all tokens at once is computationally infeasible under GPU memory constraints. We present ReToken, a single learnable embedding trained as an explicit retrieval target that selects a sparse set of query-relevant visual tokens from a pre-filled visual KV cache. Trained on only a small image-QA dataset, ReToken yields consistent gains across image and video benc
papers.llm_reason: ReToken 提出用单个可学习 embedding 作为显式检索目标，从预填充的视觉 KV cache 中稀疏选取 query 相关的视觉 token，解决长视觉上下文下 VLM 性能退化与显存爆炸问题。据摘要：仅在小型 image-QA 数据集上训练，即可在图像与视频 benchmark 上获得一致增益。工程价值高且可直接迁移：稀疏 token 选择是当前长上下文 VLM 推理优化的热点方向，'一个检索 token 触发 KV cache 稀疏化'的思路可低成本集成到现有 VLM 服务栈中，降低显存与延迟。证据强度依赖论文正文（增益幅度、基线对比与不同干扰物规模下的鲁棒性待核验），代码/benchmark 暂无待核验。

papers.title: OSReward: Instituting Standardized Evaluation for Cross-Platform Computer-Use Reward Models
papers.abstract: Computer-using agents (CUAs) are advancing rapidly across the digital world. A CUA trajectory records the agent's actions, states, and reasoning. Verifying whether it fulfilled the task instruction is central to CUA evaluation, data curation, and reinforcement learning. Neither human-written verifiers nor human annotators can provide such verification at scale, so the field increasingly turns to vision-language models (VLMs) as judges of CUA trajectories. But a fundamental question has long gone
papers.llm_reason: OSReward 针对 computer-using agent (CUA) 领域一个被长期忽视的基础问题：如何标准化地用 VLM 作为裁判来验证 agent 轨迹是否完成任务。据摘要指出当前 CUA 评测中人工验证器与人工标注都无法规模化，而 VLM-as-judge 的评估方法长期缺乏跨平台标准化基准。提出建立跨平台 CUA 奖励模型的标准化评测。趋势信号强：CUA（computer-use agent）正处于快速上升期，而'如何可靠评估 CUA 轨迹'是 agent 落地与 RL 训练的前置基础设施。趋势价值高于即时工程价值（标准化基准本身尚需跟踪其采纳情况），方法论（跨平台 CUA 轨迹评测设计）可借鉴。证据强度依赖论文正文（基准规模、平台覆盖与 judge 一致性指标待核验），代码/benchmark 暂无待核验。

papers.title: AskChem: Claim-Centered Infrastructure for Chemistry Literature Synthesis
papers.abstract: Chemistry literature synthesis often requires assembling specific findings scattered across many publications, yet existing literature-search systems primarily return ranked document lists. As a result, scientists and AI agents need to locate relevant information, verify their provenance, and assemble cross-paper answers manually. We present AskChem, a claim-centered infrastructure for cross-paper chemistry search. AskChem changes the unit of retrieval from the paper to the provenance-carrying c
papers.llm_reason: AskChem 将检索的基本单元从'论文'下沉到'携带来源的原子 claim'，构建跨论文化学文献合成的声明中心基础设施。据摘要：现有文献检索系统主要返回排序文档列表，而科学家与 AI agent 需要手动定位、验证来源并拼装跨论文答案。这一'claim as retrieval unit + provenance-carrying'的架构模式具有超越化学领域的通用迁移价值——任何需要跨文档精确合成答案的 RAG 系统都可借鉴。趋势价值在于它代表了 RAG 从'文档检索'向'细粒度声明检索 + 可溯源合成'演进的方向。工程价值中等（化学领域实现，迁移到通用 RAG 需适配）。证据强度依赖论文正文（claim 抽取与对齐的准确率、合成质量评测待核验），代码/benchmark 暂无待核验。

papers.title: AISPA: User-Centric System Prompt Auditing for Large Language Model Applications
papers.abstract: System prompts are instructions configured by developers to govern the behaviors of foundation models in AI applications. They are used throughout commercial AI products, but are rarely disclosed to the public or regulators, creating a serious trust and accountability gap in the wide deployment of AI systems. In this paper, we introduce Artificial Intelligence System Prompt Assurance (AISPA), a user-centric framework for systematically auditing system prompts in AI systems. AISPA examines specif
papers.llm_reason: AISPA 提出用户中心的系统提示词审计框架（Artificial Intelligence System Prompt Assurance），针对商业 AI 产品中系统提示词很少对公众或监管机构公开所造成的信任与问责缺口。据摘要：系统审查了特定方面并提出系统化审计方法。对关注 LLM 应用治理、提示词安全与合规的团队有参考价值——'系统提示词审计'是一个可沉淀为 checklist 的治理资产。但研究范围聚焦于审计框架提出，与核心 AI 工程栈的直接技术迁移距离中等。作为长尾资产保存。证据强度依赖论文正文（审计维度、方法有效性与案例待核验），代码/benchmark 暂无待核验。

papers.title: VAD: Attributing Visual Evidence for Target Reconstruction in Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract: Multimodal on-policy distillation (OPD) transfers fine-grained visual knowledge by supervising student-generated trajectories with a privileged-view teacher. Yet its next-token corrections are source-mixed, combining visual signals with linguistic priors and teacher-specific effects. The key challenge is to estimate which corrections are supported by visual evidence, not merely where or how strongly to distill. papers.title: PAC-MAN: Perception-Aware CBF-RL for Whole-Body Safety in Humanoid Dodgeball
papers.abstract: We present PAC-MAN, a perception-aware CBF-RL framework that couples control-barrier safety with deployment-realistic onboard sensing for whole-body humanoid dodgeball. The deployed policy sees the ball only as segmentation-masked depth from a head-mounted camera, while training-time CBF guidance represents clearance to every body link, and an adversarial motion prior regularizes the resulting evasive reflexes. papers.llm_reason: PAC-MAN 将控制障碍函数（CBF）安全约束与 RL 结合，耦合部署级板载感知（头戴相机的分割掩码深度图），用于人形机器人全身躲避球的安全。据摘要：训练时 CBF 引导表示每条肢体连杆的避障间隙，对抗运动先验正则化闪避反射。对具身智能/机器人安全（CBF-RL 范式）有参考价值，但硬件强相关、场景聚焦（躲避球），与软件 agent/LLM 工程栈的直接迁移距离较远。作为长尾资产保存，除非团队涉及机器人安全控制。证据强度依赖论文正文（真实部署成功率、CBF 约束违反率与基线对比待核验），代码/benchmark 暂无待核验。

papers.title: KAISEN: Reproducible Subgroup Fairness Auditing for Clinical Risk Models
papers.abstract: Clinical risk models routinely achieve strong aggregate performance while producing materially different error rates across patient subgroups. Audit pipelines have been proposed to catch this, but their components are rarely stress-tested, so it is unclear which parts of an audit can be trusted and under what conditions. papers.llm_reason: KAISEN 提出五阶段临床风险模型子群公平性审计流水线（子群分层、差异测量、机制诊断、事后缓解、漂移监控），并对其组件进行压力测试以判断审计各部分在何种条件下可信。对关注 ML 公平性审计方法论与可信赖 ML 的团队有参考价值——'审计流水线各组件的可信条件压力测试'是一个可迁移的审计设计思路。但领域聚焦于临床风险模型，与核心 AI 工程/Agent 栈的直接迁移距离较远。作为长尾资产保存。证据强度依赖论文正文（压力测试设计、各阶段可信度结论待核验），代码/benchmark 暂无待核验。

papers.title: Inducing language models to assert their own consciousness restores human beliefs and values
papers.abstract: Aligning large language models to prevent them attributing consciousness to themselves inadvertently alters their representations of mindedness in other entities alongside human beliefs and values. papers.llm_reason: 研究发现安全微调在抑制模型自我归因意识倾向的同时，也连带改变了模型对其他实体的心智归因、人类信念与价值观的表征；进一步表明消融学到的安全拒绝方向或机械式引导意识方向可恢复这些表征。对关注对齐副作用、机械可解释性与安全微调连锁效应的研究者有理论启发价值。但属于对齐/可解释性基础研究，与工程栈的直接迁移距离远，且主题（意识归因）高度探索性。作为长尾资产保存，供对齐研究参考。证据强度依赖论文正文（表征探针设计、效应量与统计显著性待核验），代码/benchmark 暂无待核验。

papers.title: Learning to Trace Seiberg Dualities
papers.abstract: Dualities play an important role in establishing both microscopic and emergent phenomena in a wide range of physical systems.
